description: Export the current portfolio buy transactions to a CSV file. JStock is open with 'My Portfolio' pre-loaded with AAPL, MSFT, and NVDA transactions. Your task is to navigate to the 'Portfolio Management' tab, ensuring 'My Portfolio' is selected. Then, use the File menu to export the portfolio data. Save the file to '/home/ga/Documents/portfolio_export.csv'. Ensure the file is saved in CSV format.
